metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Lenin Pandiyan
metas.description: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district. By the orders from a steadfast judge, to ensure protection & safeguard them from the vindictive political system, they nominate a weakest unassuming rookie police constable .The emotional bond between the rookie policeman and the couple & how they avenge the entrenched political system with fortuitous incidents as a new found allies forms the rest of the narrative.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Sonar Kella
metas.description: A young boy becomes a target for crooks, after he claims to remember his past life and mentions precious jewels in a golden fortress.

metas.name: Maheshinte Prathikaaram
metas.description: Mahesh, a studio photographer and studio owner gets into a fight and loses. He ends up taking revenge which leads to certain realizations in his life.

metas.name: Dangal
metas.description: Mahavir Singh Phogat, a former wrestler, decides to fulfill his dream of winning a gold medal for his country by training his daughters for the Commonwealth Games despite the existing social stigmas.

metas.name: Naduvula Konjam Pakkatha Kaanom
metas.description: A young man forgets a few years of his life, even as he is about to get married.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: PK
metas.description: An alien on Earth loses the only device he can use to communicate with his spaceship. His innocent nature and child-like questions force the country to evaluate the impact of religious views on people.

metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: Six short stories that explore the extremities of human behavior involving people in distress.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1
metas.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

metas.name: Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa
metas.description: An aspiring filmmaker goes through the ups and downs of romance when he falls for a Christian woman who says she only wants to be friends.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: Paul Atreides arrives on Arrakis after his father accepts the stewardship of the dangerous planet. However, chaos ensues after a betrayal as forces clash to control melange, a precious resource.

metas.name: Badhaai Ho
metas.description: A man is embarrassed when he finds out his mother is pregnant.

metas.name: Pizza
metas.description: A pizza delivery boy lands in a mysterious circumstance and it works a dramatic change in his life.

metas.name: Karthikeya 2
metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: Atonement
metas.description: Thirteen-year-old fledgling writer Briony Tallis irrevocably changes the course of several lives when she accuses her older sister's lover of a crime he did not commit.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: Two brothers in 1910s California struggle to maintain the favor of their affectionate but strict, Bible-toting father as an old secret about their long-absent mother comes to light.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description: A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: Kapoor & Sons
metas.description: The story about two brothers who visit their dysfunctional family for their grandfather's birthday party.

metas.name: Sam Bahadur
metas.description: Revolves around the high and low points of Sam Manekshaw who became the first Indian Army officer to be promoted to the rank of Field Marshal.

metas.name: Sookshma Darshini
metas.description: Manuel returns with his mother to their former home in a middle-class neighbourhood. Suspicious of his intentions, Priyadarshini and her friends begin gathering clues, convinced he may be hiding something sinister.

metas.name: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
metas.description: Two wily online scammers mend their fraudulent ways after meeting the girls of their dreams - until a deceitful discovery throws their world for a loop.

metas.name: Khaleja
metas.description: When a mysterious illness ravages a remote village, the villagers embrace a reluctant taxi driver as their savior.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Rahasya
metas.description: A Doctor stands accused of killing his own eighteen-year old daughter. While this aggrieved father protests his innocence, all evidence points towards him irrefutably.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: Badlapur
metas.description: Raghu begins walking a fine line between good and evil as he exacts violent revenge on two criminals who killed his family 15 years ago.

metas.name: Awarapan
metas.description: A loyal henchman is ordered by his boss to keep an eye on his mistress, and trouble begins when he refuses to kill her.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: BlackBerry
metas.description: The story of the meteoric rise and catastrophic demise of the world's first smartphone.

metas.name: Psycho Raman
metas.description: Ramanna, a maniac murderer, finds a soulmate in Raghavan, a policeman, who inspects his murder cases. He tries to make Raghavan realize how they both are similar.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Te3n
metas.description: A grandfather, a priest and a police officer investigate the case of a kidnapped child.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: King Kong
metas.description: A greedy film producer assembles a team of moviemakers and sets out for the infamous Skull Island, where they find more than just cannibalistic natives.
